description: Administrators only, and this one CHANGES things: mark an open invoice on this machine paid by hand — money that came outside the payment page, or none. 'method' is 'bank' (a wire), 'crypto' (coin sent straight to us, not through the page), 'cash', or 'comp' (no money: the whole rest of the bill is closed and counted as nobody's revenue). The bill then settles exactly as a paid one does: the period is granted, the plan it was issued for is switched on, the customer gets the «paid» letter, and the company's journal names you with the reason. 'reference' (the bank's, the transaction's, the receipt's) is required except for comp and is the idempotency key: the same reference again records nothing and answers recorded=false. Refused for a company a card or app store renews, for a bill that is no longer open, and for another machine's bill (the answer names the machine). Take the invoice id from admin_invoices.

amount.description: How much came, in the bill's own currency. Left out: what is still owed. Ignored for comp.

closeInFull.description: Close the bill even though less came; the rest is written off as its own row.

invoiceId.description: The invoice's id on its machine, as admin_invoices lists it.

method.description: How the money came: bank, crypto, cash or comp.

reason.description: Why — read a year from now by whoever asks what happened. Required.

reference.description: The money's own reference. Required except for comp.

shard.description: The machine the bill lives on, as admin_invoices says ('shard'). Left out: this one.

name: admin_mark_invoice_paid
title: Admin mark invoice paid
